project.name: Hope Townscape Guide
project.boundarySource: ONS Built-up Areas (December 2024) with curated adjoining public green spaces
project.researchNotes: Townscape Guides batch audit completed 2026-08-11. Local Cadw and National Monuments Record of Wales data and current public OpenStreetMap records were filtered point-in-polygon. The original settlement boundary is preserved in townStudyArea; 8 directly adjoining public green-space geometries and 0 reviewed visitor extensions were included in the active visitor boundary.

touristAppeal.label: Not a tourist town
touristAppeal.summary: Hope has recorded local interest, but its current in-boundary visitor offer does not meet the threshold for a tourist-town rating.

townGuide.headline: A practical local guide to Hope
townGuide.intro: Hope has a modest visitor offer within its active settlement boundary. The guide records defensible heritage and practical stops without presenting the place as a destination.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: Church of St Cyngar
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Start with Church of St Cyngar and Bridge End Bridge, then use the planner for an in-boundary daytime stop.
